findings.mechanism: The w-l-y occurrence carries supportive alignment, q-d-m carries forward placement, n-f-s locates the act in the agents' own selves, and x-l-d B002 supplies attachment and remaining. Their cross-root contact turns the focus consequence chain into self-forwarded preparation rather than an externally arriving result.
findings.reader_payoff: The condemnation remains a judgment on their alliance while making visible how present loyalty can participate in preparing the future state named at the end.
findings.containment: This is an intrinsic focus resonance grounded by four accepted focus branch records and the trusted cross-run support. It does not replace the direct claim that many ally with disbelievers and incur divine displeasure and punishment; the source's weak retrieval grade keeps the wider synthesis qualified.

findings.title: A self-provisioned state of withholding
findings.claim: The focus's selves forwarding a condemned outcome can also meet the punitive word's supplied sweet-water and withholding facets: the act becomes a pictured provisioning of withheld provision, a material contrast to the freely flowing habitat elsewhere in the packet.
findings.mechanism: The focus q-d-m B002 occurrence supplies prior effect, the focus ʿ-dh-b B001 and B003 occurrences supply sweet consumption and withholding, and exact 5:62 and 5:85 coordinates supply illicit intake and freely running water. Their contact creates an anti-provision resonance around the focus consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The punishment can be perceived as a state toward which the selves have sent a corrupted provision, while the direct reading of divine displeasure and abiding punishment remains in view.
findings.containment: This is a branch-distant, exploratory material resonance. It is not an etymology of punishment and does not claim literal thirst. The exact context Arabic and focus branch records anchor the contact, while the HFT segmentation and unresolved context branches remain attributed; the supplied alternative reading keeps ordinary punishment as the direct sense.

epistemic.reason: The trace has exact focus, 5:62, and 5:85 coordinates and exact focus branch records, but explicitly marks the cross-domain relation branch-distant and exploratory.
